capabilities: Add annotations to selected text with multiple variants
Switch variants and replace displayed text in real time
Navigate annotations in a sidebar grouped by heading levels
Back up annotation data automatically with rolling retention
Export the full text of all selected variants
disambiguation: Despite the Footnote Compass name, it does not manage Markdown footnotes; its annotations are inline text passages with switchable variants.
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English); the plugin was awaiting community marketplace review at the time of writing, with manual installation instructions and a QQ support group provided.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep multiple alternate versions of a passage (plot directions, dialogue) in place and switch between them while drafting fiction.
summary: Annotation plugin for novel writers that adds branching variants to selected text and navigates them from a heading-grouped sidebar.
